frozen_at: before widened discovery; no stage-2 outcome from the widened repository set had been inspected

additional_constraints.note: A class that cannot be filled honestly is filled by widening discovery again, never by relabelling a confirmed case, substituting an easier class, or manufacturing a fixture.

substitution_policy: No post-result substitution. Surplus confirmations are retained as pre-run candidates in the rejected/candidate log and may only be promoted if a selected case is withdrawn during label review, and only into the same cause class.
